The space is enclosed by metal mesh fencing on both sides and features a heavy barred gate in the background leading to a darker interior room. The architecture suggests an old institutional building, likely a prison or jail.

The texture of the floor becomes muddy and lacks consistent perspective lines as it recedes into the shadow.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the visual features (bars, brick, mesh) strongly align with the 'prison' class label versus generic industrial or historical sites.
To analyze the depth consistency of the narrow corridor and ensure the background gate and room are spatially grounded correctly relative to the foreground subject.
To inspect the complex geometry of the mesh fence and barred gate for melting, broken loops, or impossible connections.
To evaluate the anatomical correctness of the woman and check for subtle skin/texture artifacts common in AI-generated humans.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the metal mesh and bars (no melting/fusion).
Spatial coherence of the narrow corridor (perspective lines).
Anatomical correctness of the human subject (hands, posture).
Texture realism of the brickwork and metal surfaces.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the metal mesh with the brick walls; AI often fails to render the physical attachment points correctly. Also, verify that the background room through the gate maintains consistent lighting and perspective with the foreground corridor.
